mentions.name: FeedSync
mentions.description: This tool syndicates RSS feed posts to Discord, designed to be simple to set up and run unattended ("just work", set and forget). A forthcoming feature uses an Elixir Lua runtime to build custom feeds by parsing HTML.
mentions.source_excerpt: I'm building a RSS <> Discord syndication tool called [FeedSync](https://feedsync.net).
